description: Discover a site's stack before acting: WP/PHP versions, active theme, installed plugins (active flag), and detected frameworks (WooCommerce, Elementor, ACF). Read-only; requires the key's `site:read` scope. Always call this first on an unfamiliar site.

site.description: Site alias to target (e.g. "guns2ammo"). Omit when only one site is configured.

name: bridgistic_get_site_info
title: Get WordPress site info
